Who are we?

Tripledot Studios is one of the largest independent mobile games companies in the world.

We are a multi-award-winning organisation, with a global 2,500+ strong team across 12 studios.

Our expanded portfolio includes some of the biggest titles in mobile gaming, collectively reaching top chart positions around the world and engaging over 25 million daily active users.

Tripledot’s guiding principle is that when people love what they do, what they do will be loved by others.

We’re building a company we’re proud of. One filled with driven, incredibly smart and detail-orientated people, who LOVE making games.

Our ambition is to be the most successful games company in the world, and we’re just getting started.

The role is working within our studio: Ludios

About Ludios

Ludios takes its name from the Latin, it means "The Game People". Led by Eyal, one of the co-founders of Tripledot Studios, and some of the most experienced people in mobile games, we are a studio that makes and publishes our own casual, free-to-play mobile games. Our team is based across APAC, with the majority of our development happening in Jakarta and Melbourne. We are data-driven, creative, and genuinely passionate about the industry we work in. Right now, we are working on a number of exciting projects, including one built around a globally recognised IP, alongside several original titles we are equally excited about. If crafting games and reaching millions of players is what gets you out of bed, we would love to hear from you.

Role Overview

We're hiring a Software Quality and Automation Engineer to own our automated testing setup for mobile games. You'll help support and work with QA, the game engineers and technical leadership to run and grow our physical device lab, an automated gameplay harness and the AI tools that support our testing. We expect you to use AI coding agents, LLMs and vision models every day to build and maintain this tooling, and not to hand-write large suites of fragile UI scripts. A big part of the job is finding testing work the team currently does by hand, like performance checks, memory profiling and hardware compatibility runs, and automating it so it runs reliably without supervision.

Key Responsibilities

• Run our iOS and Android device lab. This covers automated build deployment, overnight runs, device health and thermal recovery, and coordinating tests across devices.
• Build AI-assisted testing workflows. You'll use LLMs, vision models and agent harnesses to play through the game automatically, spot visual and UI problems, sort crash logs and write regression reports people can act on.
• Automate performance, memory and compatibility profiling. That means collecting frame times and 1% lows, memory use (PSS, graphics memory, swap/ZRAM), thermal state, and GPU and shader data on Vulkan, GLES and Metal, then comparing each result against that device's own baseline.
• Write and extend the in-game automation hooks, debug bridges and telemetry exporters in Unity (C#), plus the host-side scripts that drive them.
• Make it easy for QA analysts to start, review and extend automated tests. Work directly with developers to get reliable repro steps for crashes, OOMs and driver bugs before they ship.
• Wire smoke, compatibility and performance regression tests into our build pipeline so every release candidate gets checked on our minimum-spec and legacy devices.

Required Skills, Knowledge, and Expertise

• 4+ years of professional software engineering or technical QA automation experience, ideally in games, mobile apps or device testing.
• Real, day-to-day experience working with AI. You use coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex or your own setup) to prototype, refactor and debug quickly, and you've built LLM APIs, structured outputs or vision models into automation or triage pipelines.
• Solid C# and Unity experience, or strong experience in another engine plus the ability to read, extend and debug existing game and editor code.
• Comfort with Python, TypeScript/Node.js and Bash for orchestration, data processing and reporting.
• Hands-on experience with iOS and Android tooling: adb, xcrun/devicectl, iOS provisioning and signing, crash symbolication, and profilers such as Perfetto, Xcode Instruments, the Unity Profiler and RenderDoc.
• Experience with Git, CI/CD (GitHub Actions, Jenkins, TeamCity or similar), automated builds and storing test metrics.
• A practical attitude. You care about catching bugs, OOMs and frame drops that players would actually hit, and you'd rather build something simple that keeps working than add process for its own sake.

Nice to have

• Experience running a physical mobile device farm over USB or the network, including powered hubs, heat management and recovering older devices without someone on hand.
• Knowledge of Vulkan, OpenGL ES or Metal, shader compilation and PSO caching, or working within tight memory limits on low-end phones.
• Experience building MCP servers, custom agent skills or bot frameworks for game testing.
